# data/external/rxnorm/ — untracked RxNorm snapshot

Place a locally acquired RxNorm RRF release here (e.g. `RXNCONSO.RRF`,
`RXNREL.RRF`, `RXNSAT.RRF`, `RXNSTY.RRF`). Git-ignored. Never committed.

The exact organizer 2026 release is undisclosed (see
`configs/organizer/unresolved_policies_v1.yaml::UNRES-RXNORM-RELEASE`). Record the
acquired release in a manifest under `data/manifests/` before ingesting.
